title: Botryoid
summary: BO'TRYOID BOTRYOI'DAL, adjective [Gr. a bunch of grapes, and form.] Having the form of a bunch of grapes; like grapes; as a mineral presenting an aggregation of small gloves.

inlines.v: BO'TRYOID BOTRYOI'DAL, adjective [Gr. a bunch of grapes, and form.] Having the form of a bunch of grapes; like grapes; as a mineral presenting an aggregation of small gloves.
